briefdescription.para: Driver implementation for the TI INA745A/B digital power monitor.

detaileddescription.para: Bus-agnostic core driver for the INA745A/B (40V, 16-bit, precision I2C digital power monitor with integrated 800µΩ shunt). The core only uses injected HAL callbacks (ina745a_i2c_write_f / ina745a_i2c_read_f) and never includes drivers/i2c/i2cWrapper.h or any BSP header directly. Their signature matches i2c_writeRegMultipleBytes()/i2c_readRegMultipleBytes() in drivers/i2c/i2cWrapper.h, so no adapter module is needed - callers pass them in directly via a function-pointer cast (see ina745a.h).
There is no calibration register (unlike INA226/INA228): the integrated shunt is factory-trimmed, so all LSB sizes are fixed constants (see ina745a.h and datasheet Table 8-1).

Multiple simultaneous instances are supported analogous to tpsm8286x: ina745a_initialize() takes an explicit 'devId' that directly indexes the static instance pool (size INA745A_NUM_INSTANCES, defined in userDef.h).
